review_method: Inspect code paths and named positive/negative assertions against each invariant, exact source provenance and declared platform evidence.
procedure: Run focused five-module Windows qualification with a fresh synthetic root, actual early native Linux and Windows CI gates, complete platform regressions and both-role package lifecycle checks. Inspect exact source, native failure assertions, canary reports and completed workflow logs identified in reviewed-validation.md.
expected: Desktop and headless existing-file modes operate without agent/display/unlock prompts; unsupported modes fail closed without plaintext configuration fallback.
observed: Actual Linux33 native cases pass in both CI and Desktop. Local focused156 pass/33 Linux skips; full CI1893 pass/17 skips/4 known xfails, Linux Desktop1904 pass/15 skips/4 xfails, Windows Desktop1847 pass/72 skips/4 xfails. Existing nativeWindows15 and shared-policy regression pass. Both-role bundle/GUI/install/uninstall/profile checks pass on both OSs. platform_scope: Windows x64 local/hosted and Ubuntu Linux x64 hosted. Explicit 15 Windows or33 Linux native skips on other OS; no ARM64/XFS field or live home topology qualification claimed.
negative_cases: Unsupported SSH agent, SecretService, auto, interactive-unlock or invalid modes refuse before any native key access.
Wrong UID/GID/groups/session/namespaces, changed filesystem credentials, missing trust, purpose or expiry deny helper admission.
Missing/exclusively locked store, broad or inaccessible modes, masked extended/default ACLs, hard links and unsafe path components refuse.
Real symlink/parent alias/FIFO/directory/empty/oversized/tmpfs sources refuse; no blocking FIFO open or external ACL repair occurs.
Source replacement, missing path, parent/file permission change, content rotation with restored timestamp and held-handle changes invalidate admission.
Sealed memory rejects write/grow/shrink; edits to original cannot change already-admitted snapshot; borrowed handle is invalid after use.
Real fork/setsid cannot use parent-session binding; unavailable memfd closes all owned descriptors and preserves external files.
Lost/raw/malformed helper acknowledgement maps UNKNOWN without replay; public reports/repr/captured output exclude synthetic canary and protected key path.
Exact mount parser rejects ext2/ext3 shared magic, unsupported type, mismatch, missing/duplicate/malformed/oversized tables.
Bounded fixture IDs preserve65537-byte negative input without exceeding Windows environment limits; existing Windows and RP006 regressions remain required.
unverified_scope: Durable protected bindings, passphrase/key parsing, actual authenticated remote helper integration and live deployment remain later gates. Existing key mode excludes agents/SecretService/unlock prompts. No forensic memory erasure, mandatory Linux file locking or retrospective cancellation of admitted effects.
rollback: Revoke only installation-local references and close owned descriptors; retain external keys/permissions/profiles and installed legacy runtime.
